nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: The Collector's plate lies in pieces on the bridge. His keys hang at his belt.

nodes.speaker: class-redmage
nodes.line: You took his plate off with an axe. I like you already.

nodes.speaker: class-barbarian
nodes.line: Took all night to learn. Worth it.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: His chest is on the white wagon. Gold, a flask, a book. And the wagon is ours now too.

nodes.speaker: class-redmage
nodes.line: He kept that book from me for a month. Let me read it, and I'll show you what it's for.
